pioDesignation: Central Public Information Officer, EPFO Regional Office
appellateAuthority: First Appellate Authority, EPFO Regional Office (Regional Provident Fund Commissioner)
filingAddress: EPFO Regional Office holding the PF account — per applicant's jurisdiction
notes: For pension sanction, family pension, and pension stoppage. PF withdrawal/transfer claims go to epfo-provident-fund instead.

pioDesignation: Central Public Information Officer, EPFO Regional Office
appellateAuthority: First Appellate Authority, EPFO Regional Office (Regional Provident Fund Commissioner)
filingAddress: EPFO Regional Office holding the PF account — per applicant's jurisdiction
notes: For withdrawal/transfer claim delays and rejections. Quote the UAN and claim ID.

authorityName: Office of the Tehsildar / Revenue Department
pioDesignation: Public Information Officer, Revenue Department (District)
appellateAuthority: First Appellate Authority, District Collectorate (Additional District Collector)
filingAddress: District Collectorate, Revenue Department — per applicant's district
verifyAt: State revenue department portal for the applicant's state
notes: Land is a State subject — the correct office and portal differ by state.

authorityName: Office of the Superintendent of Police / Commissioner of Police
pioDesignation: Public Information Officer, District Police Headquarters
appellateAuthority: First Appellate Authority, Office of the Superintendent / Commissioner of Police
filingAddress: District Police Headquarters — per jurisdiction of the police station concerned
verifyAt: State police department website for the applicant's state
notes: FIR copies and investigation status are disclosable. Case diary access is restricted and may be refused under Section 8(1)(h) while investigation is ongoing.

pioDesignation: Public Information Officer, State Education Board
appellateAuthority: First Appellate Authority, State Board of Secondary Education (Secretary)
filingAddress: State Board of Secondary Education, Head Office
verifyAt: State education board website for the applicant's state
notes: Evaluated answer sheets are disclosable following CBSE v. Aditya Bandopadhyay (2011).

authorityName: Department of Food, Civil Supplies and Consumer Affairs
pioDesignation: Public Information Officer, Food & Civil Supplies Department
appellateAuthority: First Appellate Authority, District Food & Civil Supplies Office
filingAddress: District Food & Civil Supplies Office — per applicant's district
verifyAt: State food and civil supplies department portal

pioDesignation: Central Public Information Officer, Regional Passport Office
appellateAuthority: First Appellate Authority — the Regional Passport Officer of the concerned RPO
filingAddress: Regional Passport Office for the applicant's jurisdiction (37 RPOs nationwide)
notes: Quote the passport file number. Delays often sit with police verification, which is held by the state police, not the RPO.

pioDesignation: Public Information Officer, Electricity Distribution Company (Circle/Division Office)
appellateAuthority: First Appellate Authority, Electricity Distribution Company (Superintending Engineer or equivalent)
filingAddress: Divisional or Circle office of the DISCOM serving the applicant's connection
verifyAt: DISCOM website for the applicant's state
notes: State DISCOMs are public authorities. Quote the consumer number.

authorityName: Municipal Corporation / Municipal Council (Urban Local Body)
pioDesignation: Public Information Officer, Municipal Corporation (Zonal/Ward Office)
appellateAuthority: First Appellate Authority, Municipal Corporation (Deputy/Additional Commissioner)
filingAddress: Municipal Corporation head office or the ward office for the applicant's area
verifyAt: Municipal corporation website for the applicant's city
notes: Covers civic services, certificates, property tax and local works. Urban local bodies are explicitly public authorities under the Act.

authorityName: Water Supply and Sewerage Board / Municipal Water Department
pioDesignation: Public Information Officer, Water Supply and Sewerage Board
appellateAuthority: First Appellate Authority, Water Supply and Sewerage Board (Executive/Superintending Engineer)
filingAddress: Divisional office of the water board or municipal water department for the applicant's area
verifyAt: Water board or municipal website for the applicant's city
notes: In many cities water supply sits inside the municipal corporation rather than a separate board.

pioDesignation: Central Public Information Officer, Office of the jurisdictional Assessing Officer / CPC Bengaluru
appellateAuthority: First Appellate Authority, Income Tax Department (Additional/Joint Commissioner of the concerned range)
filingAddress: Jurisdictional Income Tax Office, or CPC Bengaluru for processing and refund matters
notes: Refund and return-processing matters usually sit with CPC Bengaluru; assessment matters with the jurisdictional AO. Quote the PAN and assessment year.

pioDesignation: Public Information Officer, Regional Transport Office
appellateAuthority: First Appellate Authority, Office of the Transport Commissioner / Regional Transport Officer
filingAddress: Regional Transport Office for the applicant's district
notes: Quote the application, licence or vehicle registration number.

pioDesignation: Public Information Officer, Office of the Chief Medical Officer / Medical Superintendent
appellateAuthority: First Appellate Authority, Office of the Chief Medical Officer / Medical Superintendent
filingAddress: Chief Medical Officer, District Health Office, or the Medical Superintendent of the hospital concerned
notes: Covers government facilities and scheme entitlements. A patient's own records are disclosable; third-party medical records may be refused under Section 8(1)(j).

authorityName: Department of Social Welfare / Social Justice
pioDesignation: Public Information Officer, District Social Welfare Office
appellateAuthority: First Appellate Authority, District Social Welfare Office (District Social Welfare Officer)
filingAddress: District Social Welfare Office — per applicant's district
notes: Distinct from EPFO pension: covers non-contributory state welfare pensions (widow, old-age, disability).

authorityName: District Rural Development Agency (DRDA) / Block Development Office
pioDesignation: Public Information Officer, District Rural Development Agency / Block Development Officer
appellateAuthority: First Appellate Authority, District Rural Development Agency (Project Director / CEO Zilla Parishad)
filingAddress: Block Development Office or DRDA for the applicant's block/district
notes: MGNREGA records including muster rolls are proactively disclosable. Quote the job card number.

pioDesignation: Public Information Officer, Gram Panchayat (Panchayat Secretary)
appellateAuthority: First Appellate Authority, Block Development Office (Block Development Officer)
filingAddress: Gram Panchayat office of the applicant's village, or the Block Development Office
notes: Panchayats are public authorities. Local works, fund utilisation and Gram Sabha minutes are disclosable.

pioDesignation: Central Public Information Officer, Bank (Zonal/Regional Office)
appellateAuthority: First Appellate Authority, Bank (General Manager, Zonal/Regional Office)
filingAddress: Zonal or Regional Office of the bank concerned
verifyAt: RTI page on the bank's official website
notes: Only public sector banks are public authorities. Private banks (HDFC, ICICI, Axis and similar) are NOT covered — for those, file with the Reserve Bank of India for information the RBI holds about them.

pioDesignation: Central Public Information Officer, Divisional Railway Manager's Office / IRCTC
appellateAuthority: First Appellate Authority, Divisional Railway Manager's Office (Senior Divisional Officer) / IRCTC
filingAddress: Divisional Railway Manager's office of the concerned division, or IRCTC for e-ticketing and refunds
notes: E-ticket refunds sit with IRCTC; station, train and recruitment matters with the zonal/divisional railway. Quote the PNR.

pioDesignation: Public Information Officer, Housing Board / Development Authority
appellateAuthority: First Appellate Authority, Housing Board / Development Authority (Deputy/Additional Commissioner)
filingAddress: Head or regional office of the housing board or development authority concerned
verifyAt: Website of the applicant's state housing board or development authority
notes: Covers allotment, possession delays and scheme records. Quote the application or allotment number.

pioDesignation: Public Information Officer, District Collectorate
appellateAuthority: First Appellate Authority, District Collectorate (Additional District Collector)
filingAddress: District Collectorate — the district implementing the works
notes: The district administration implements and holds records for MP/MLA local area development works.

pioDesignation: Central Public Information Officer, Head Post Office / Divisional Office
appellateAuthority: First Appellate Authority, Office of the Postmaster General / Senior Superintendent of Post Offices
filingAddress: Head Post Office or Divisional Postal Office for the applicant's area
notes: Crucial for tracking mail delays, missing articles, and post office savings schemes (PPF, SCSS, Sukanya Samriddhi). Quote the tracking/account number.

pioDesignation: Central Public Information Officer, RBI Regional Office / Central Office
appellateAuthority: First Appellate Authority, RBI Regional Office (Regional Director) / Central Office
filingAddress: RBI Regional Office of the concerned state, or Central Office in Mumbai
notes: Private banks (HDFC, ICICI, etc.) are NOT covered under RTI. To get information regarding a private bank's compliance or regulatory action, citizens must file the RTI with the RBI.

pioDesignation: Central Public Information Officer, LIC Divisional / Branch Office
appellateAuthority: First Appellate Authority, LIC Divisional Office (Senior Divisional Manager)
filingAddress: The LIC Branch or Divisional Office where the policy is serviced
notes: Only public sector insurance companies (LIC, GIC, New India Assurance, etc.) are public authorities. Quote the policy number.

pioDesignation: Central Public Information Officer, NHAI Project Implementation Unit (PIU)
appellateAuthority: First Appellate Authority, NHAI Regional Office (Regional Officer)
filingAddress: NHAI Project Implementation Unit (PIU) for the specific highway stretch
notes: For state highways or local roads, the RTI should be routed to the State Public Works Department (PWD), not NHAI.
ministry: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways

authorityName: Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) / Staff Selection Commission (SSC)
pioDesignation: Central Public Information Officer, UPSC / SSC
appellateAuthority: First Appellate Authority, UPSC / SSC (Joint Secretary level)
filingAddress: Headquarters or Regional Office of UPSC/SSC
notes: Candidates can request their own evaluated OMR sheets/answer copies. Third-party scores may be exempted under Section 8(1)(j). For state-level exams, route to the State Public Service Commission.
ministry: Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions

pioDesignation: Public Information Officer, State Pollution Control Board (Regional Office)
appellateAuthority: First Appellate Authority, State Pollution Control Board (Member Secretary)
filingAddress: Regional Office of the State Pollution Control Board
notes: While the CPCB exists centrally, most local environmental enforcement, factory clearances, and complaints are handled by the State Pollution Control Board.

pioDesignation: Public Information Officer, Office of the Registrar / Controller of Examinations
appellateAuthority: First Appellate Authority, Office of the Vice Chancellor / Registrar
filingAddress: Administrative block of the respective university
verifyAt: Official website of the specific university
notes: Central universities are 'central', state universities are 'state'. Private universities are generally NOT covered directly, but records can be sought via the UGC or state higher education department.

pioDesignation: Central Public Information Officer, UIDAI Regional Office
appellateAuthority: First Appellate Authority, UIDAI Regional Office (Deputy Director General)
filingAddress: UIDAI Regional Office covering the applicant's state
notes: Citizens can request their own authentication logs. Advise users NEVER to include their actual 12-digit Aadhaar number in the RTI application text for privacy reasons; use the Enrolment ID (EID) or masked identifiers instead.
ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology

authorityName: Department of Women and Child Development (WCD)
pioDesignation: Public Information Officer, Child Development Project Officer (CDPO) / DPO
appellateAuthority: First Appellate Authority, District WCD Officer
filingAddress: Office of the Child Development Project Officer (CDPO) for the local block, or District Programme Office
notes: Used heavily for records related to Anganwadi food distribution, beneficiary lists, maternity scheme payouts, and worker appointments.

pioDesignation: Central Public Information Officer, DoT TERM Cell / BSNL Circle Office
appellateAuthority: First Appellate Authority, DoT / BSNL Circle Office
filingAddress: TERM Cell (for cell tower radiation) or BSNL Circle office (for BSNL complaints)
notes: Private telecom operators (Jio, Airtel, Vi) are not under RTI. To get information on private telcos (like tower legality or regulatory fines), citizens must file with TRAI or the DoT.

authorityName: Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation (DICGC)
pioDesignation: Central Public Information Officer, DICGC
appellateAuthority: First Appellate Authority, Chief General Manager, DICGC
filingAddress: DICGC, Reserve Bank of India Building, Opp. Mumbai Central Railway Station, Byculla, Mumbai - 400008
notes: A wholly-owned RBI subsidiary that insures deposits when a bank fails or goes into liquidation. Use this when a bank has collapsed or is under moratorium and the depositor is chasing their insured amount — not for ordinary complaints against a working bank.

authorityName: Bharatiya Reserve Bank Note Mudran Private Limited (BRBNMPL)
pioDesignation: Central Public Information Officer, Corporate Office
appellateAuthority: First Appellate Authority, Chief General Manager, BRBNMPL Corporate Office
filingAddress: BRBNMPL Corporate Office, BTM Layout, Bengaluru, Karnataka - 560029
notes: Prints currency notes for the RBI. Much of what is asked here is refused under Section 8(1)(a) (security and economic interests of the State); recruitment, tender and administrative records are the realistically disclosable part.

pioDesignation: Public Information Officer, State RERA
appellateAuthority: First Appellate Authority, State RERA
filingAddress: Head office of the Real Estate Regulatory Authority for the applicant's state
verifyAt: State RERA portal (for example https://rera.mp.gov.in for Madhya Pradesh)
notes: Covers registered project files, builder financial disclosures and occupancy certificates. Quote the RERA project registration number. RERA cannot be asked to justify its own quasi-judicial orders through RTI — that needs an appeal to the Real Estate Appellate Tribunal. Private disputes with no registered developer are outside its remit.

pioDesignation: State Public Information Officer & Additional Registrar (Establishment)
appellateAuthority: First Appellate Authority, Registrar General of the High Court
filingAddress: Office of the Additional Registrar, principal seat of the High Court having jurisdiction over the applicant's state
verifyAt: Official website of the relevant High Court
notes: Covers the court's ADMINISTRATIVE side only — staff recruitment, tenders, infrastructure and budgets. Certified copies of case papers by a party to a case go through the High Court Rules for certified copies, not through RTI; records of active litigation are protected.

pioDesignation: Registrar / Secretary, State Information Commission
appellateAuthority: Chief State Information Commissioner
filingAddress: State Information Commission of the applicant's state (for example, Information Building, Arera Hills, Bhopal for Madhya Pradesh)
verifyAt: State Information Commission portal for the applicant's state
notes: This is where a SECOND appeal under Section 19(3) goes when a STATE authority's PIO and First Appellate Authority have both failed you. It is not a place to file an original RTI. It can order disclosure and impose penalties on a PIO under Section 20.

pioDesignation: Registrar, Central Information Commission
appellateAuthority: Chief Information Commissioner
filingAddress: Central Information Commission, Baba Gang Nath Marg, Munirka, New Delhi - 110067
notes: Second appeals under Section 19(3) against CENTRAL public authorities only. Filing a state matter here gets it dismissed for want of jurisdiction — state matters go to that state's Information Commission.
